from pathlib import Path
import os
import subprocess
try:
    pid_text, start = Path('/home/user/.cache/mdcbench/vlc_331_process_baseline').read_text(encoding='utf-8').split()
    pid = int(pid_text)
    stat_text = Path(f'/proc/{pid}/stat').read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()
    end = stat_text.rfind(')')
    fields = stat_text[end + 2:].split()
    same_start = end >= 0 and len(fields) > 19 and fields[19] == start
    command = Path(f'/proc/{pid}/cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\x00', b' ').decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    same_media = '/home/user/media/evening_breeze_demo.wav' in command and 'vlc' in command.casefold()
    windows = subprocess.run(['wmctrl', '-lp'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5, check=False)
    visible = False
    for line in windows.stdout.splitlines():
        parts = line.split(None, 4)
        if len(parts) == 5 and parts[2] == str(pid):
            title = parts[4].casefold()
            visible = 'vlc' in title and 'evening_breeze_demo' in title
            if visible:
                break
    ok = same_start and same_media and visible
except Exception:
    ok = False
print('present' if ok else 'missing')
